definitions.explanation: A removable fabric cover for a futon (Japanese-style bedding), used to keep the futon clean and to allow easy washing.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}カバー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}した→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{布団|ふとん}カバー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{替|か}えた→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed to a new futon cover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{布団|ふとん}カバー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧や⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like to change the color and material of my futon cover to match the season.

notes:
USAGE:
A common household item in Japan. {布団|ふとん}カバー can refer to covers for both the ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ (duvet/comforter) and ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧ (mattress pad), though it most often refers to the duvet cover.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布団|ふとん}カバー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける (to put on a futon cover)
- {布団|ふとん}カバー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to remove a futon cover)
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}カバー (duvet cover)
- ⟦{敷|し}き→敷く：00366_shiku⟧{布団|ぶとん}カバー (mattress cover)
